viewFromHomeOnly: This is in Settings on {mac} only. Choose it on this card there.
viewFromHomeOnlyThere: This is in Settings on your first mate's computer only. Choose it on this card there.
viewGoogleUpdateThere: Update Infinitary on {mac} to sign in to Google from here.
viewHomeUpdateAsksPassword: This update asks for a password, so it is installed at the computer itself.
viewHomeUpdateAtComputer: This copy is updated at the computer itself, not from afar.
viewHomeUpdateConfirmJobs: Background jobs that stop at the restart: {jobs}.
viewHomeUpdateConfirmNoTasks: No crewmate is running work there now.
viewHomeUpdateConfirmNoUndo: If the new version does not start, someone needs to be at {name}. It cannot be undone from here.
viewHomeUpdateConfirmTasks: Running work finishes first, then carries on after the restart: {tasks}.
viewHomeUpdateElsewhere: {name} has {version} ready to install at the computer itself.
viewHomeUpdateFailed: The update on {name} did not finish.
viewHomeUpdateNoWindow: Infinitary's window did not open on the computer, so the update did not start. Try again, or update it there.
viewHomeUpdateNotBack: {name} has not come back after the update. Someone needs to check it at the computer.
viewHomeUpdateResuming: {name} is resuming work the update paused.
viewHomeUpdateWaitingFor: Waiting for {tasks} to finish what is running.
viewPillNewerHears: {name} has a newer Infinitary. Your first mate still hears your messages, and buttons come back once Infinitary on this computer is updated.
viewPillOlderHears: {name} has an older Infinitary. Your first mate still hears your messages, and buttons come back once Infinitary there is updated.
viewReturnPasteLabel: The address your browser ended on after {name}
viewReturnPasteLead: Approve on {name}'s page. Your browser then ends on a page that cannot be reached. Copy that page's address and paste it here.
viewReturnPasteRefused: That address is not this sign-in's. Paste the address your browser ended on after this sign-in.
viewWorkAppPlace: This computer cannot run work for {home}: Infinitary opens from a disk image or its download folder. Move it to Applications, open it from there, then try again.
viewWorkBackgroundOff: This computer cannot run work for {home}: Infinitary is not allowed to run in the background. On a Mac, turn it on in System Settings › General › Login Items, then try again.
viewWorkLocalNetwork: This computer's work has not reached {home}: macOS has not let Infinitary use your local network. Allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network, then try again.
viewWorkNoBackground: This computer cannot run work for {home}: it has no way to run Infinitary in the background.
viewWorkNotReached: This computer's work runs, but it has not reached {home}.
viewWorkOtherEntry: This computer cannot run work for {home}: it already runs that work as another computer on its Devices list. Remove that one there, then try again.
viewWorkOtherHome: This computer cannot run work for {home}: it already runs another first mate's work.
viewWorkRemovalUnfinished: This computer cannot run work for {home} yet: an earlier removal here has not finished.
